Both our encoder and decoder have 6 layers with 512-dimensional word embeddings and hidden states. We employ 8 heads and dropout with a rate of 0.3. For optimization, we use Adam optimizer with $\beta_{2} = 0.998$ and set batch size to 4096 tokens. Meanwhile, we increase learning rate linearly for the first warmup_steps, and decrease it thereafter proportionally to the inverse square root of the step number. We set warmup_steps to 8000. The similar learning rate schedule is adopted in (Vaswani et al., 2017). Our implementation uses the openNMT library (Klein et al., 2017). We train the models for $250\mathrm{K}$ steps on a single GeForce GTX 1080 Ti GPU. Our code is available at https://github.com/QAQ-v/HetGT.
